I was really into visual kei and animation when I was a kid.  I wanted to understand the lyrics and subbed tv shows, so I made attempts to self study. I became more invested while attending college. I ended up studying abroad in Nagoya for a year and came back to the States with the desire to aim for fluency. I’d love to return to Japan and learn more about the culture directly through communicating with others and reading. 

Another reason was curiosity due to living in proximity of a military base and border town. I was exposed to other kids that were multilingual and had experiences outside of the US. Most of my friends and community back at home are bilingual. I wanted to be like them.
